title: feat(plugin-grid): a phone list card row is the title, one subtitle line and one status chip
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao3wPRrD2ji5jSfkJhwo4Pz8)_

Fixes #28484

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机（小于 768 px）列表的卡片行改成看板的列表行：名称字段作标题，一行副标题（前两个显示列的值用「 · 」连接，脱敏值和空值跳过），右侧一个状态标签，不再逐列画「标签 … 值」；放大的相关列表页签在手机上也用同一种卡片行。
- 为什么改：原卡片每条线索约 138 px，首屏只放得下 3 条多；看板要求约 60 px 一行、首屏十行。现在实测 62 px 一行。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 768 px 以下的卡片面；卡片上的金额/日期/百分比改为与桌面单元格同一个渲染器（例如金额显示 ¥1,234,567 而不是 ¥1.2M）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`（`buildMobileCardRenderer` 非 compact 分支）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`（手机 grid/table 分支的放大页签）、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/scripts/build-css.mjs`（换了两个样本类）。
- 两分钟验证：手机宽度（390 px）打开 CRM 的 Leads 列表，每行应是「名字 / 公司 · 来源 / 右侧状态标签」，无「Company」「Lead Source」字样。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Phone list card row** (`ObjectGrid`'s card face below 768 px, plain and grouped lists): title = the declared name field (unchanged resolver); one subtitle line joining the first two shown columns that are neither the title nor the status field, each drawn through its own desktop cell, separated by " · ", with a masked or empty value skipped; one status chip at the right, which is the column `detectStatusField` (`@object-ui/types`, the resolver the record path and kanban lanes read) names, drawn through that column's own cell. No per-column label lines. The name-keyword heuristics the card used (amount / stage / date / percent by column name, the stage colour and left-border tables) are removed, so every value reads as the desktop row draws it.
- **Enlarged related tab on a phone** (`RelatedList`, the `isMobile` grid/table arm, enlarged face only, per claim amendment 1): hands an `object-grid` node with the rows it already read inline (`provider: 'value'`), its columns and `onRowClick`, instead of the inset `object-gallery`. Resolved through the registry, since `plugin-grid` depends on `plugin-detail`. Compact related cards and every non-enlarged phone related list keep the gallery.
- A row tap still hands the row to the host's `onRowClick`; 768 px and up are unchanged.
- Root changeset `28484-phone-list-card-row.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`).

## Tests

- New `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardRow-28484.test.tsx` (390 px): title by the declared name field, subtitle `Dev Admin · Atlas Construction`, one status chip drawn through the select cell (`New Lead`, never the stored `new`) as the card's last child, no label lines, empty and masked subtitle values skipped (raw value nowhere in the DOM), row tap reaches `onRowClick`; control at 768 px draws the table. Ablation: the file run against the `origin/main` `ObjectGrid.tsx` goes 6 failed / 1 passed (the 768 px control), restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- New `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.enlargedPhoneCards-28484.test.tsx`: the enlarged tab at 390 px hands `object-grid` its inline rows and columns, `onRowClick` reaches the host; controls: non-enlarged on a phone keeps `object-gallery`, enlarged at 1280 px keeps `data-table`.
- Moved onto the new face (rewritten, none deleted): `ObjectGrid.emptyPlaceholderAffordance-8491` (the control reads the value, no label line), `gridCurrencyFaces.displayLocale-9909` (the subtitle amount in the session locale), `maskedColumnSurfaces-10583` (only the title draws the mask; masked subtitle values are skipped), `mobileCardDateLocale` (the date cell's face), `mobileCardFieldCurrency-10423` (the field currency through the desktop cell), `mobileCardTitleNameField-13150` (subtitle text).
- Ledgers the old face carried: `ui/scripts/__tests__/percent-storage-callers-11475.test.ts` drops the `ObjectGrid.tsx` mobile-card `formatPercent` row (the call is gone); `plugin-grid/scripts/build-css.mjs` `MUST_SURVIVE` swaps `border-l-[3px]` and `dark:bg-slate-950/40` (only the old card produced them) for `min-w-[140px]` and `dark:bg-emerald-950/20`, both still produced by this package alone, keeping one arbitrary-value and one dark-variant specimen.

## Acceptance notes

- Subtitle values are each column's desktop cell, so a select column draws its badge and a percent column its bar inside the one subtitle line (visible in the shots: lead source as a chip, probability as a bar). The board frame shows plain text; trimming cells to text would be a second display path, so this PR keeps one.
- With no status field (`detectStatusField` answers null, including an object whose `stageField` is `false`) or with the status field not a shown column, the card draws no chip. The old card picked a "stage" by column name (`priority`, `category`, …); that guess is gone.
- Enlarged related tab: cards now span x 32 to 358 of 390 (body content 24 to 366, minus the card list's own 8 px gutter, the same gutter the plain phone list has at x 8 to 382). Before: x 40 to 350.

## Verification

Head `d63d4c94`, `origin/main` base `1f1a369b`.
